summary: Bounce light: screen-space GI that lets sunlit walls, paving and roofs light what faces them in their colours.
stage: game capture at 1600x900, --offscreen --perf=0 --nohud: --host --team=0 --seed=3 --preset=high with FL_DEBUG_GI_CYCLE (frozen frame, off then High) at --mood=day (FL_DEBUG_GI_POSES ruin:ruin:14:-58:0.4 and rts55:town:55:auto:0.6 for the command height), --mood=golden / overcast (ruin30:ruin:30:auto:0.4, the game's own pitch) and --mood=night (car16:car:16:auto:0.5 with FL_DEBUG_GI_IGNITE=0.9 FL_DEBUG_STEADY_FIRE=1 FL_DEBUG_GI_AT=14, a car set alight beside a wall); the tank: --scenario=tank --static --seed=3 --mood=day with FL_DEBUG_GI_AT=3 FL_DEBUG_GI_POSES=t3:tank:12:auto:4.71, and the dust comparison the same at t2:tank:12:auto:3.14 before and after the opaque picture (Snap); each shot cropped (640x360 at 2x, or 960x540) on the window with the most added light, off stacked over on with labels, an arrow and a 'look at' caption, plus the same crop as on-minus-off x4; flicker clip: the same crops alternating off/on each second; pan clip: --fixed-fps 30 with FL_DEBUG_GI_POSES=p:town:40:-40:1.57 FL_DEBUG_GI_PAN=6,-6,75 FL_DEBUG_GI_MODES=view_added --mood=day (the added light alone, gamma-brightened)
rationale: Bounce light is a change in shade, so each shot is cropped tight on exactly where it lands, off stacked over on so the same pixels sit one above the other, with an arrow and a one-line caption naming what to look at, and a bounce-only panel showing where the light lands and its colour. It is shown at its strongest (midday), in golden hour and overcast from 30 m, from the 55 m command height, at night beside a burning car, and on a tank standing on sunlit grass (what this pass adds for vehicles). A three-way crop shows the dust fix (off, before, now) in one look, since it is about what must not show. A flicker clip toggles off/on in place; a pan clip of the added light answers whether it smears in motion. Every shot was re-rendered for this pass, since the fog of war's shade now darkens the bounce light under it.
